title: Ring scene labels: one key shows all numbers, one shows all labels, and in ring mode the hovered ring's number follows the cursor
description:
User 2026-10-25: there are several number/label toggles today (N ring numbers, shift+N region numbers, shift+P part names) and it is not clear what a number refers to. The user rejected prefixes and per-ring colours as noise. Instead:
1. One control row (stable action id, explicit key) shows or hides all numbers: ring numbers and region numbers together.
2. One control row shows or hides all labels (part names).
3. In ring mode (the ring tool's ring and bisector sub-tools), hovering a ring moves that ring's number to the cursor (beside it, not under it), so which ring a number belongs to is obvious where you are looking; the other numbers stay where they are.
Replace the existing separate toggles rather than adding to them; keep everything reachable through `tools`/`control` for agents.

ADDED (user, 2026-10-25, screenshot in the orbit tool): part names start visible, but their toggle only exists in the region tool, so in any other tool they cannot be turned off. The two rows (all numbers, all labels) are scene rows of the ring scene, available from every tool (orbit, ring, bisector, region, connection, graph), like the ring numbers today. Both start off, so a freshly opened scan shows no text until asked.

ADDED (user, 2026-10-25): colouring by part follows the labels toggle: regions are coloured by part only while the part labels are shown; with labels off the scene shows its default colours (the region colours in the region tool, the plain surface elsewhere). No separate colour-by-part toggle (P) is needed; remove it.

Concrete case (user, 2026-10-25): G in the ring tool (show region colours) shows the part colours whenever colour-by-part was left on in the region tool (P), and only the region tool can switch it back. After this ticket G always shows the default region colours unless the part labels are shown.

CHANGED (user, 2026-10-30): the graph tool, which replaces the 3D view, does not keep N and P; numbers and labels there would toggle text the user cannot see. The rows are ordinary RingScene.setControls rows, carried by the scene inheritance chain to every tool over the scene's view; no new hook on Scene.
definition-of-done:
1. Two rows, all numbers and all labels, replace today's three; tests.
2. Hovering a ring in ring mode draws its number at the cursor; leaving the ring puts it back; tests.
3. Screenshots on IMG_4111 with numbers on, labels on, and a hovered ring.

4. Both rows are scene-level and fire from every tool in the ring scene; numbers and labels start off; test.

5. Part colouring is on exactly when part labels are shown; default colours otherwise; the separate colour-by-part toggle is gone; test.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test.
2. Live through ixdar-cli (hover a ring, read words).
changes-made: RingScene: two scene rows every tool keeps (new Scene.setEveryToolControls hook, so the graph tool keeps them too): toggle-numbers (N) shows ring and region numbers, toggle-labels (P) shows part names; both start off. Removed toggle-ring-numbers, the region tool's toggle-part-names (shift+P), toggle-region-numbers (shift+N) and toggle-colour-by-part (P), and RegionLayer.colourByPart/showPartNames/showRegionNumbers. RegionLayer.colouredByPart(): regions take part colours exactly while labels show (then coloured in every tool); otherwise region colours where they show (G, region tool, bisector) and the plain surface elsewhere, fixing G in the ring tool showing part colours. Hovered ring number: RingScene.updateScene sets the number whose ring the active tool's hovered() item names aside as hoveredRingNumber and draws it just right of the cursor; BisectorTool.hovered() now reports the wall a click would snap to, and ClosedRingTool labels a hovered graph ring with its drawn number (graph label in detail). Tests: 3 new in RegionControlAutomationTest (rows in every tool incl. bisector and graph, key and id, start off; part colouring vs G; hovered number moves and returns), existing ones moved to the new ids. Live on IMG_4111-named: words 0 at start, labels/numbers fired from orbit and region tools, G labels-off vs on image-diff 182611 px differ and labels-off again 0 px, hovering ring 8/4 moves its number from centred on the cursor to 10 px right, back on leave, same in the bisector; P fires from connection tool, toggle-labels from the graph tool.

Review fix (2026-10-30): removed Scene.setEveryToolControls, its call in refreshControls and the Tool.replacesView doc reference; N and P moved into RingScene.setControls, so Scene.java and Tool.java match master. The every-tool test now leaves out tools that replace the view. Finished the interrupted sync onto master 0c58726c and updated partColouringFollowsTheLabelsRowAndGShowsRegionColoursWithLabelsOff to master's Palette (palette.region/categories/warning/surface via Palette.shadedEntry). RegionControlAutomationTest 17/0.
review-summary: RingScene now has two rows in every tool, N for all ring and region numbers and P for all part labels, both off at start; RegionLayer colours by part exactly while labels show, and a hovered ring's number moves beside the cursor. Three separate toggles confused which number meant what.
